meta.project: Cets On Gold (CETS) — a Flap launchpad FlapTaxTokenV3 clone
meta.snapshot_note: All live values captured on BSC mainnet during assembly; see live-state/ for block-stamped snapshot.

contracts.name: CETS token (Cets On Gold)
contracts.role: The target. ERC20 with 3% buy/sell tax paid out as XAUt (Tether Gold) dividends. State (balances, config, owner) lives here; logic runs from the implementation via delegatecall.

contracts.name: FlapTaxTokenV3 implementation
contracts.role: The actual token logic the CETS clone runs. Tax calc, _liquidateTax, _processTax -> TaxProcessor, dividend share updates -> Dividend.

contracts.name: TaxProcessor (clone)
contracts.role: Holds collected tax; swaps CETS->XAUt via PancakeSwap and routes to fee/market/dividend. HOLDS XAUt for holders. owner = Portal.

contracts.name: TaxProcessorUniV2 implementation
contracts.role: Tax processing logic. _swapTokensForQuote uses amountOutMin=0 (no slippage guard). withdrawAll(token,to) onlyOwner sweep. Delegates admin to TaxProcessorAdminImpl, dispatch to TaxProcessorV2DispatchImpl.

contracts.name: Dividend (clone)
contracts.role: Tracks holder shares and distributes XAUt dividends. HOLDS XAUt for holders. emergencyWithdraw(token,amount,to) onlyOwner sweep. owner = Portal.

contracts.name: Dividend implementation
contracts.role: Dividend accounting (magnified-dividend-per-share). setShare onlyTaxToken. emergencyWithdraw onlyOwner. distribute/withdraw permissionless.

contracts.name: XAUt (Tether Gold) — proxy
contracts.role: The quote/dividend asset. Real Tether Gold OFT on BSC, 6 decimals. UPGRADEABLE by its proxy admin (0xedaba0...). Every XAUt held by CETS's contracts and pool depends on this implementation.

contracts.name: XAUt TetherTokenOFTExtension implementation
contracts.role: Tether Gold OFT logic. Governs mint/burn/blacklist of the gold-backed quote asset.

contracts.name: PancakeSwap V2 Router
contracts.role: Router the TaxProcessor calls to swap CETS->XAUt and add liquidity. Canonical PancakeSwap V2 router.

contracts.name: PancakePair CETS/XAUt
contracts.role: The CETS/XAUt V2 pool (mainPool). token0=XAUt, token1=CETS. Where tax liquidations sell and where price is discovered.

contracts.name: PancakeSwap V2 Factory
contracts.role: Factory that created the pair; router reads it. Canonical.

contracts.name: WBNB
contracts.role: Wrapped BNB (weth of the system). Used as router intermediary / weth alias. Canonical.

contracts.name: SwapRegistry — proxy
contracts.role: Immutable swapRegistry in TaxProcessor. Used ONLY when dividendToken != quoteToken (Case 3). INACTIVE for CETS (dividendToken == quoteToken == XAUt). Implementation is UNVERIFIED — behavior recovered.

contracts.name: SwapRegistry implementation (UNVERIFIED)
contracts.role: Unverified. Recovered: implements ISwapRegistry (24/31 selectors match) + pool-inspection helpers; AccessControl-gated; live multiDexRouter/defaultThreshold/weth read out. Not in CETS active value path.

contracts.name: Portal — proxy (owner of TaxProcessor & Dividend)
contracts.role: THE OWNER of TaxProcessor and Dividend. Whoever controls this controls the onlyOwner sweeps (withdrawAll/emergencyWithdraw) and receiver config. Upgradeable by ProxyAdmin 0xB248...

contracts.name: Portal implementation (Flap launchpad)
contracts.role: Flap launchpad entrypoint. AccessControl (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, AUDITOR_ROLE, GUARDIAN_ROLE). Deploys token/tax/dividend clones. Owner of every Flap token's tax & dividend contracts.

contracts.name: ProxyAdmin (Portal)
contracts.role: Can upgrade the Portal implementation. Owned by the launchpad-admin Safe. Upgrading the Portal is a path to reaching the owned fund contracts.

contracts.name: ProxyAdmin (SwapRegistry)
contracts.role: Can upgrade the SwapRegistry implementation. Owned by an EOA (0x8187F1...).

contracts.name: Launchpad-admin Safe (3-of-4)
contracts.role: ULTIMATE AUTHORITY. Holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE on the Portal AND owns the Portal's ProxyAdmin. 3-of-4 multisig. Controls the entire Flap launchpad and therefore CETS's fund contracts.

contracts.name: Fee-receiver Safe (3-of-4)
contracts.role: TaxProcessor feeReceiver (protocol fee destination). 3-of-4 multisig sharing 3 signers with the launchpad-admin Safe.

contracts.name: SafeL2 singleton (v1.4.1)
contracts.role: Logic behind the launchpad-admin Safe. Canonical Safe deployment.

contracts.name: GnosisSafeL2 singleton (v1.3.0)
contracts.role: Logic behind the fee-receiver Safe. Canonical Safe deployment.

contracts.name: MultiDexRouter
contracts.role: Router the SwapRegistry would use for Case-3 dividend swaps. INACTIVE for CETS (Case 3 not used). Included because reachable from the swapRegistry the TaxProcessor stores.

eoas_and_offchain.note: Receives the market share of processed tax (marketBps). Externally owned — no code, no on-chain constraints.
LP tokens from _addLiquidity and deflation burns are sent here.
Single EOA that can authorize upgrades to the (platform-shared) SwapRegistry. Not in CETS active path but a platform-level single point of trust.
Can upgrade the Tether Gold implementation. Tether's own infrastructure, external to this project, but an authority over the quote asset.
